name: callcrmnew
title_zh: 14 个技能打包卖，拆开用才值回票价
tagline_zh: 不是合集目录，是 14 个独立工具。每个都解决一个具体麻烦，装一个包等于挑了 14 次货，但每个都能单独卸。
tagline_en: Not a directory—14 standalone tools. Each solves one specific pain. One install, 14 picks, and you can remove any.
why_zh: 每个技能都独立成件，不互相依赖。想用哪个调哪个，不用的不占 prompt 空间，比整包加载干净得多。
why_en: Each skill stands alone with zero cross-dependencies. Load only what you need—no prompt bloat from the rest.
limit_zh: 只含 14 个技能，不覆盖这 14 个之外的任何场景。安装后需逐个查看说明才知道各自触发词，没有统一入口或菜单。
limit_en: Only these 14 skills—nothing beyond them. After install, you must read each skill's own description to learn its trigger; no unified menu or launcher.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 14 skills in one pack; use them separately to get your.
